description: AI-powered SSH terminal, Windows RDP remote desktop and local shell for VS Code: SFTP/ZMODEM and RDP CLIPRDR file transfer, AI command execution, log monitoring, command audit and multi-server batch ops.
config.dataDir.description: Data directory for connections, sessions, AI config and audit logs. Leave empty to share ~/.aicmd with the desktop app / CLI and reuse the same connections.json.
config.startPort.description: Starting port used when launching the AICmd service inside VS Code. If occupied, the extension scans forward for a free port.
